study type: Secondary analysis of a multicenter prospective observational study
exposure: cervical ripening with a synthetic osmotic dilator (Dilapan-S)
cohort: 444 pregnant women at >32 weeks gestation who underwent cervical ripening with Dilapan-S.
finding: Higher Bishop scores after cervical ripening with Dilapan-S were associated with higher rates of vaginal delivery, with scores <5 potentially warranting further ripening.
mod_finding: Vaginal delivery rates were significantly correlated with Bishop scores before and after Dilapan-S treatment and their difference.
